title: Dice push-your-luck
tagline: Roll again or bank it? One unlucky roll ends the turn.
teaser: Roll the die to build a turn total, then bank it before a one takes it away. First to the target wins.

manPage.synopsis: pig — roll to build points, hold to keep them, avoid the one.
manPage.description: The BSD pig program translated text into Pig Latin. We borrow its name for the family dice game called Pig.

howToPlay: Roll the die to build your turn total.
Stop whenever you like to bank it.
Roll a one and you lose that turn’s points.
